## Problem

A property owner, fleet, charging developer, broker, installer or investor needs address-specific EV infrastructure diligence that keeps public facts, observed evidence, modeled assumptions and unresolved engineering questions separate.

## Inputs

Street address plus the buyer decision question. Paid site reports require the address and buyer email; deeper diligence may use authorized site-specific inputs.

## Outputs

Address-specific RIVET site opportunity report with charging competition, demand/traffic evidence where available, utility/tariff and incentive context, site-fit signals, modeled economics boundaries and next diligence.

## Pricing

$299 Preliminary Site Opportunity Report; $750 Full Site Opportunity Report.

- RIVET Preliminary Site Opportunity Report: $299 (one_time)

- RIVET Full Site Opportunity Report: $750 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: RIVET is a first-class Evercraft Machine Commerce identity for the $299 Preliminary and $750 Full Site Opportunity Reports. The underlying address-intelligence engine remains internal to the commercial handoff. Checkout preparation is human-confirmed and paid state requires provider verification.

Agents may discover RIVET and inspect current report options. Secure checkout preparation requires explicit human payment confirmation, buyer email and address. Checkout creation is not payment proof; paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments / provider-verified payment authority. Discovery and agent routing have no silent payment authority.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
